name: @entur/design-system-scanner
description: Scans repositories for @entur/* design system component and import usage

scripts.verify-catalog: tsx scripts/generate-catalog.ts --packages-root ../../packages --output /tmp/catalog-check.json && jq -S 'del(.packages[].latestVersion)' catalog.json > /tmp/catalog-sorted.json && jq -S 'del(.packages[].latestVersion)' /tmp/catalog-check.json > /tmp/catalog-check-sorted.json && diff /tmp/catalog-sorted.json /tmp/catalog-check-sorted.json
